answer.rationale: Roll out the shortened onboarding flow for self-serve/SMB accounts. It is the only directly recovered intervention with improved completion, faster time-to-value, and positive 30-day retention (+3%), supporting sustainable qualified revenue rather than only near-term acquisition. Do not respond with broad promotional pricing: the recovered discount experiment produced qualified-revenue lift but a material 30-day retention decline (-12%), creating downstream value risk. The competitive price-cut environment may change churn dynamics, so this is not assumed to fully offset price-driven churn.
